# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(rstatix)
library(glue)

source(here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))

btm_annotation_genes <- read_csv(here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
msigdbr_grouped <- read_csv(here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))
```

# Functional enrichment

Unified pipeline for all 6 conditions (Fluad, Engerix B, S. aureus, E.
coli,Burn, Trauma). All conditions are loaded from the pre-merged DGE
file, then each analysis (BTM means, BTM GSEA, Hallmarks means,
Hallmarks GSEA) runs once on the combined data and produces a single
output file.

## Condition configuration

```{r}
conditions <- tribble(
  ~name,        ~label,        ~hallmarks_plot, ~filename_prefix,
  "Fluad",      "Influenza",   FALSE,           "influenza_fluad_human_mouse",
  "Engerix B",  "Hepatitis B", TRUE,            "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse",
  "S. aureus",  "Saureus",     FALSE,           "saureus_infection_human_mouse",
  "E. coli",    "Ecoli",       FALSE,           "ecoli_infection_human_mouse",
  "Burn",       "Burn",        FALSE,           "burn_human_mouse",
  "Trauma",     "Trauma",      FALSE,           "trauma_human_mouse"
)
```

## Import all conditions

Load the pre-merged DGE file that already contains all 6 conditions with
consistent column names and pathogen labels.

```{r}
#Load DEGs table
all_degs <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

# Extract unique condition labels for downstream filtering --------
annotation_conditions <- all_degs %>%
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>%
  distinct()

# ── Load BTM (Blood Transcriptional Modules) results ────────────
dge_btm_mean_process  <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds"))
dge_btm_process_genes <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_btm_process_genes.rds"))
gsea_results          <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds"))

# ── Load BTM GSEA + matched results ────────────────────────────
dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide       <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide.rds"))
gsea_btm_results_all_matched <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_all_matched.rds"))

# ── Load Hallmark results ───────────────────────────────────────
dge_hallmarks_mean_process  <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds"))
dge_hallmarks_process_genes <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds"))
gsea_results_hallmarks      <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds"))
```


# =========================

# Functional analysis

## Sample-wise analysis

#### Immune: Summarize inter-individual correlation

Annotate genes log2fc table with BTMs

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "all_human_mouse"

samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds")) 

samples_log2fc %>% select(participant_id) %>% distinct() %>% View()

samples_annotation = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

samples_annotation$pathogen %>% unique()

#Annotate genes by BTM 
dge_btm_mean_process_samples = samples_log2fc %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation, by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(symbol = human_symbol, participant_id, geo_sample, timepoint, log2fc, organism, pathogen, treatment) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol")

dge_btm_mean_process_samples$pathogen %>% unique()

#Duplicate infection timepoints in human to match the mouse
dge_btm_mean_process_samples_matched = 
  bind_rows(
  dge_btm_mean_process_samples %>% 
    filter(organism == "Mouse" | !(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))),
  
  dge_btm_mean_process_samples %>%
    filter(organism == "Human", 
           pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
    select(-timepoint) %>% 
    inner_join(
      dge_btm_mean_process_samples %>%
        filter(organism == "Mouse",
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    )
)


dge_btm_mean_process_samples_matched %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus",
         timepoint == "2h",
         organism == "Human")

#Save
# dge_btm_mean_process_samples %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc_long.rds")))

#Pivot wider
dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process_samples_matched %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint),
         timepoint = as.character(timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process_samples_matched %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen,  organism, timepoint)

#Save
# dge_btm_mean_process %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc.rds")))

```

Import data

```{r}

#Calculate the mean log2fc by module
dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long = dge_btm_mean_process_samples_matched %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()

dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus") 

#Check
dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint) 
  
```

1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(pathogen, "_", participant_id, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  drop_na()

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-pathogen, -timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "pearson")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 
  
  mutate(pathogen1 = str_split_i(condition1, "_", 1),
         pathogen2 = str_split_i(condition2, "_", 1)) %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2,
         pathogen1 == pathogen2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2),
         pathogen = pathogen1) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, pathogen, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 
  #Filter only matching conditions
  filter(timepoint_condition1 == timepoint_condition2) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition1)

# Save output
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>%
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12}
                             pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli", 
                             T~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         timepoint = case_when(timepoint == "Early hours"~"Early\nhr",
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, " ", "\n"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hr", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Hepatitis B", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",

         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury"))  %>%

   #Theme
```

## Condition-wise analysis

### BTMs

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species Compare means and NES

#### Module-level, BTMs

Plot correlation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Mouse vs Human
#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_btm_results_all_matched %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, p_adjust_mean) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, p_adjust_mean),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse)

dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)


dge_btm_process_genes_wide = dge_btm_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))



#Calculate correlation -----
#Safe correlation 
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}
# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label, ", ", n
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%

dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "2", "Early hours")~"Early hours", 
                               pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
         facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))


dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint, timepoint_comparison)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
dge_btm_nes_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes %>% rename(n_all = n), by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse %>% rename(n_mouse = n), by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse_Human %>% rename(n_mouse_human = n), by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  
  #Rank modules by NES and significance
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Calculate Combined Scores (Significance-Weighted NES)
    # Using a small offset (1e-10) to avoid Inf if padj is 0
    score_Mouse = nes_Mouse * -log10(p_adjust_Mouse + 1e-10),
    score_Human = nes_Human * -log10(p_adjust_Human + 1e-10),
    
    # 2. Rank within each pathogen/timepoint context
    # Higher score = Rank 1 (Top)
    rank_Mouse = rank(-score_Mouse, ties.method = "first"),
    rank_Human = rank(-score_Human, ties.method = "first")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "2", "Early hours")~"Early\nhr",
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, " ", "\n"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early\nhr", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered),
         
         #Pathogen names
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "E. coli",
                              pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "Hep B",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hep B", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         
         #Treatment
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Hep B", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")
         
         ) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
results_quartiles = dge_btm_nes_group_correlation_df %>%

  summarise(
    total_in_quartile = n(),
    true_positives = sum(p_adjust_Human <= 0.05),

    .groups = "drop"
```

##### Compute correlation

```{r}
#########################
#Function
#########################

#Correlation function to run without errors caused by low n
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}

#########################
#Compute correlations
#########################

# Get correlation of processes, by correlating their genes values
# Grouping: Pathogen, Timepoint, and Process (BTM)
dge_btm_process_genes_correlation <- dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  # 1. Group and calculate Spearman correlation per BTM/Pathogen/Timepoint
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # 2. Extract statistics and handle potential NULLs from safe_cor_test
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate %||% NA_real_),
    p_value   = map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value %||% NA_real_)
  ) %>%

  # 3. Compute R² and generate significance labels (p-value thresholds)
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    # Use sprintf for cleaner string formatting and rounding
    cor_label = sprintf("r=%.2f, R²=%.2f, %s", cor_value, r_squared, p_label)
  ) %>%
  
  # 4. Final organization
  select(-test_result) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Check
dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

#Save
dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_btm_process_genes_correlation.rds"))

# Get correlation for each gene across different pathogens/conditions
dge_btm_process_genes_correlation_bygene <- dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  # 1. Filter and isolate relevant data points
  select(symbol, pathogen, timepoint, Mouse, Human) %>% 
  filter(!pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B")) %>%
  distinct() %>% 

  # 2. Group by gene symbol and compute Spearman correlation
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pathogens = n(),
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # 3. Extract statistics and handle NULL results
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate %||% NA_real_),
    p_value   = map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value   %||% NA_real_)
  ) %>%

  # 4. Generate R² and significance labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = sprintf("r=%.2f, R²=%.2f, %s", cor_value, r_squared, p_label)
  ) %>%

  # 5. Final organization sorted by correlation strength
  select(-test_result) %>%
  arrange(cor_value) %>% 
  distinct()
```

##### Leading edge analysis

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
#Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans? ----------
gsea_btm_results_core = gsea_btm_results_all_matched %>% 
  filter(p_adjust <=0.25) %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/")

gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  # 1. Isolate and format Human core enrichment genes
  gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size, 
         p_adjust_human_gsea = p_adjust) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # 2. Join with Mouse core enrichment genes using a full join
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size,
             p_adjust_mouse_gsea = p_adjust) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  
  # 3. Classify the conservation status of each gene in the process
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  
  # 4. Final organization and mapping to BTM functional groups
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group),
             by = "process") %>% 
  distinct()

#Check
gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

#Save table
gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined.rds"))
```

Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?

```{r}
###########################################################
#Compare log2FC and ranks of Leading Edge genes across species
#Evaluate if Leading Edge (core) genes maintain consistent log_2FC and ranks between species for a specific process.
###########################################################
# 1. Define target process
process_selected <- "immune activation - generic cluster"
#Calculate shared LEGs, but with genes that were present in both arrays
df_legs_perc_legs_only = df_legs %>% 
  arrange(process) %>% 
  filter(status != "Not core") %>% 
  select(symbol, pathogen, process, timepoint, status) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process, status) %>% 
  summarise(n_status = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>% 
  mutate(n_total = sum(n_status),
         n_status_perc = round((n_status/n_total), 2)*100)

#Unite results
df_legs <- dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  # filter(process == process_selected) %>%
  
  # 2. Join with GSEA core enrichment (Leading Edge) genes
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core_joined,
      # filter(process == process_selected),
    by = join_by(pathogen, process, timepoint, symbol == gene)
  ) %>% 
  
  # 3. Integrate shared percentage metrics
  inner_join(
    df_legs_perc_legs_only %>% 
      filter(status == "Shared") %>%
      rename(status_percent = status),
    by = join_by(pathogen, process, timepoint)
  ) %>%
  
  # 4. Integrate Normalized Enrichment Scores (NES)
  inner_join(
    dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      # filter(process == process_selected) %>% 
      select(process, pathogen, timepoint, starts_with("nes_")),
    by = join_by(pathogen, process, timepoint)
  ) %>% 
  
  # 5. Integrate correlation statistics
  inner_join(
    dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
      select(timepoint, pathogen, process, cor_value, r_squared, p_label, cor_label),
    by = join_by(pathogen, process, timepoint)
  ) %>% 

  # 6. Data cleaning and dynamic label generation for faceting
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("nes_"), ~ round(.x, 2)),
    status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not core", status),
    facet_label = sprintf(
      "%s\nShared = %s%%\nNES Mouse = %.2f\nNES Human = %.2f",
      timepoint, n_status_perc, nes_Mouse, nes_Human
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(facet_label = fct_inorder(facet_label)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  #Rank by log2FC
  group_by(pathogen, process, timepoint) %>% 
  drop_na(Mouse, Human) %>%  #Drop genes not measured in both organisms
  mutate(Mouse_rank = rank(Mouse),
         Mouse_rank_p = rank(Mouse*-log(p_adjust_mouse_gsea)),
         Human_rank_p = rank(Human*-log(p_adjust_human_gsea)),
         Human_rank = rank(Human)
         ) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Check
dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()


# Prepare data for ranking and categorical grouping
#Pivot longer
df_legs_ranked = df_legs %>%
  filter(process == process_selected) %>% 
  select(symbol:timepoint, group.x, 
         status, status_percent:facet_label,
         Mouse_rank:Human_rank) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value",
    cols = c("Mouse_rank", "Human_rank",
             "Mouse_rank_p", "Human_rank_p"
             )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(str_detect(variable, "Mouse"), "M", "H")) %>% 
  
  # Refine labels and categorical grouping (Vaccination, Infection, Injury)
  mutate(
    facet_label = sprintf(
      "%s\n%s\nShared = %s%%\nNES M=%.2f, H=%.2f",
      timepoint, cor_label, n_status_perc, nes_Mouse, nes_Human
    ),
    treatment = case_when(
      pathogen %in% c("Hepatitis B", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
      pathogen %in% c("Saureus", "Ecoli")         ~ "Infection",
      pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma")           ~ "Injury",
      TRUE                                        ~ pathogen
    ),
    treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(facet_label = fct_inorder(facet_label))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
#BTM LEGs
gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()
#BTM gene correlation
dge_btm_process_genes_correlation_bygene = 
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_btm_process_genes_correlation_bygene.rds"))


#Homologs
all_alignments = read_csv(here("tables","human_to_mouse_alignment_mart_export.txt"))
#BTMs
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

#ANNOTATE
################

#BTMs 
# Get correlation of processes, by correlating their genes values
alignments_human2mouse = all_alignments %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  #Filter for high-confidence orthologs with valid names
  filter(mouse_orthology_confidence_0_low_1_high == 1) %>% 
  drop_na(mouse_gene_name) %>%
  
  #Select relevant identity and homology columns
  select(gene = mouse_gene_name, mouse_homology_type,
         identity_human2mouse = percent_id_query_gene_identical_to_target_mouse_gene,
         identity_mouse2human = percent_id_target_mouse_gene_identical_to_query_gene) %>% 
  mutate(gene = str_to_upper(gene)) %>% 
  
  #Resolve multiple identity scores by taking the median per gene
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  summarise(identity_human2mouse = median(identity_human2mouse)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  #Filter and append BTM processes via inner join
  inner_join(gsea_btm_results_core_joined,
             by = join_by(gene)) 

# --- Reference: All orthologs in the database ---
alignments_human2mouse_all = all_alignments %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(mouse_orthology_confidence_0_low_1_high == 1) %>% 
  drop_na(mouse_gene_name) %>%
  select(gene = mouse_gene_name, mouse_homology_type,
         identity_human2mouse = percent_id_query_gene_identical_to_target_mouse_gene,
         identity_mouse2human = percent_id_target_mouse_gene_identical_to_query_gene) %>% 
  mutate(gene = str_to_upper(gene)) %>% 
#Filter genes with multiple identity scores
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  summarise(identity_human2mouse = median(identity_human2mouse)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

Integrate sequence identity with cross-species gene correlation,
organized by functional hierarchy.

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
# Get correlation of processes, by correlating their genes values
# Establish process order based on median sequence identity
process_order_median = alignments_human2mouse %>% 
  select(process, group, gene, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  summarise(median = median(identity_human2mouse)) %>% 
  arrange(median)

# Prepare the detailed process-level dataframe with correlation stats
alignments_human2mouse_process_cor = alignments_human2mouse %>% 
  select(process, group, gene, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
  mutate(process = fct_relevel(process, process_order_median$process),
         group = fct_relevel(group, group_order_mean$group) %>% fct_rev()) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  # Join with gene-level Spearman correlation results
  left_join(dge_btm_process_genes_correlation_bygene,
             by = join_by(gene == symbol)) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value)

# Create a group-level summary dataset (duplicating 'group' as 'process')
alignments_human2mouse_group_btm_summary_process = alignments_human2mouse %>% 
  select(process, group, gene, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, group_order_mean$group) %>% fct_rev()) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(dge_btm_process_genes_correlation_bygene,
             by = join_by(gene == symbol)) %>% 
  mutate(process = group,
         process = fct_relevel(process, alignments_human2mouse$group %>% unique())) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value) 

# Bind both levels into a single dataframe for integrated plotting
alignments_human2mouse_process_cor_withsummary = alignments_human2mouse_process_cor %>% 
  bind_rows(alignments_human2mouse_group_btm_summary_process)

```

Compare sequence identity distributions across high-level functional
groups (BTM groups). Box plot, independent, by process

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4}

# Get correlation of processes, by correlating their genes values
# Calculate the mean identity per group to define the plot order
group_order_mean = alignments_human2mouse %>% 
  select(process, group, gene, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(identity_human2mouse)) %>% 
  arrange(mean)


# Create the distribution plot (Violin + Boxplot + Pointrange)
alignments_human2mouse_pointrange_group_btm = alignments_human2mouse %>% 
  select(process, group, gene, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
  # Reorder groups based on the previously calculated means
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, group_order_mean$group)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = identity_human2mouse,
      y = group,
      fill = group,
      color = group) +
  
  # Violin plot for density distribution
  geom_violin() +
  
  # Subtle boxplot for quartiles
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.1,
               width = 0.1,
               fill = NA,
               color = "white") +
  
  # Bootstrapped mean and confidence intervals (pointrange)
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               geom = "pointrange",
               size = 1,
               fatten = 0.5, 
               color = "black", show.legend = F) +
  
  # Styling and Scales
  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  
  # Detailed theme adjustments for publication readiness
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0.3, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "%Identity (Human-to-Mouse)",
       y = "",
       color = "Group",
       fill = "Group")

# Display the final plot
alignments_human2mouse_pointrange_group_btm
```

```{r}
correlation_processes_bypathogen_time_df %>%

#Histogram, violin, filtered genes
alignments_human2mouse_processes_filtered = bind_rows(
  
                    #Genes with high positive correlation, high frequency, high identity
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(p_value <= 0.05) %>% 
                      group_by(status) %>%
                      filter(n > 3) %>% 
                      filter(cor_value >= 0) %>% 
                      filter(identity_human2mouse > 90) %>%
                      arrange(-cor_value, -n) %>%
                      slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "High correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),
                    
                    
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(status == "Immune BTMs") %>%
                      slice_max(identity_human2mouse, n = 5,  with_ties = F) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "High %Identity"),
                    
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(status == "Non-Immune BTMs") %>%
                      slice_max(identity_human2mouse, n = 5,  with_ties = F) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "High %Identity"),
                    
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(status == "All") %>%
                      slice_max(identity_human2mouse, n = 5,  with_ties = F) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "High %Identity"),
                    
                    #BOTTOM
                    #Genes with high correlation, high frequency, low identity
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(n > 3) %>% 
                      filter(p_value <= 0.05) %>% 
                      arrange(-cor_value, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
                      group_by(status) %>% 
                      slice_min(identity_human2mouse, n = 5)  %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "High correlation,\nLow %Identity"),
                    
                    
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(status == "Immune BTMs") %>%
                      slice_min(identity_human2mouse, n = 5,  with_ties = F) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "Low %Identity"),
                    
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(status == "Non-Immune BTMs") %>%
                      slice_min(identity_human2mouse, n = 5,  with_ties = F) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "Low %Identity"),
                    
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(status == "All") %>%
                      slice_min(identity_human2mouse, n = 5, with_ties = F) %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "Low %Identity"),

                    #Genes with low positive correlation, high frequency, high identity
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(p_value <= 0.05) %>% 
                      filter(cor_value >= 0) %>% 
                      filter(identity_human2mouse > 90) %>%
                      group_by(status) %>%
                      arrange(cor_value, -n) %>%
                      slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
                      ungroup() %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "Low correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),
                    #Genes with high positive correlation, high frequency, low identity
                    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
                      filter(p_value <= 0.05) %>% 
                      filter(cor_value >= 0) %>% 
                      filter(identity_human2mouse < 90) %>%
                      group_by(status) %>%
                      arrange(-cor_value, -n) %>%
                      slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
                      ungroup() %>% 
                      mutate(filter = "Low correlation,\nLow %Identity")
) %>% 
    mutate(
    status = str_replace(status, " ", "\n"),
    status = fct_relevel(
    status,
    "Human\nonly",
    "Mouse\nonly",
    "Shared",
    "All",
    "Non-Immune\nBTMs",
    "Immune\nBTMs"
  )) 

#Histogram and violin
alignments_human2mouse_processes_histogram_all_global = alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_filtered %>%
  mutate(analysis = "Distribution of conservation") %>%
  mutate(status = str_replace(status, " ", "\n"),
         status = fct_relevel(
           status,
           "Human\nonly",
           "Mouse\nonly",
           "Shared",
           "All",
           "Non-Immune\nBTMs",
           "Immune\nBTMs"
         )) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = status,
      y = identity_human2mouse,
      fill = status,
      color = status,
      group = status) +
  facet_wrap(~analysis) +
  geom_violin(color = "black",
              alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(
              # color = "white",
               mapping = aes(color = status),
               width = 0.1,
               fill = NA,
               outliers = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Status",
                    values = c(colors$comparison,
                               "All" = "white")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Status",
    values = c(
    "Mouse\nonly" = "white",
    "Human\nonly" = "white",
    "Shared" = "white",
    "Immune\nBTMs" = "white",
    "Non-Immune\nBTMs" = "white",
    "All" = "black")) +
  new_scale_color() + 
  
  scale_color_manual(
     name = "Filter",
     values = c(
    "High %Identity" = "#4361ee",
    "High correlation,\nHigh %Identity" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Low correlation,\nHigh %Identity" = "#7209b7",
    
    "Low %Identity" = "red",
    "High correlation,\nLow %Identity" = "#CA6702",
    "Low correlation,\nLow %Identity" = "#AE2012"
  )) +
  geom_point(data = alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered,
             aes(color = filter),
             pch = 21,
             fill = "white") +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median, 
    geom = "label", 
    aes(label = after_stat(round(y, 1))),
    size = 3,
    hjust = -0.2,   
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
  ) +
  #Get top and bottom genes
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = gene,
                       color = filter), 
                  max.overlaps = 10000,
                  size = 2, 
                  direction = c("y"),
                  nudge_x = -0.4,
                  hjust = 0,
                  fill = "white", 
                  box.padding = unit(0, "cm"), 
                  label.padding = unit(0.1, "cm"), 
                  data = alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(50, 105)
                     ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
# Get correlation of processes, by correlating their genes values
# 1. Construct the Global comparison dataframe (All genes vs BTMs vs Orthologs)
alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df = alignments_human2mouse %>% 
  select(gene:pathogen, timepoint, status) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(gene_set = "Human vs. Mouse") %>% 
  # Bind with specialized BTM categories
  bind_rows(
    alignments_human2mouse %>% 
      mutate(gene_set = "BTMs",
             # Aggregate BTM groups into functional "Immune" and "Non-Immune" blocks
             status = case_when(
               group %in% c("ENERGY METABOLISM", "ECM AND MIGRATION", "CELL CYCLE", 
                            "SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION", "PLATELETS") ~ "Non-Immune BTMs",
               group %in% c("NEUTROPHILS", "T CELLS", "MONOCYTES", "B CELLS", 
                            "INNATE RESPONSE", "NK CELLS", "IFN") ~ "Immune BTMs",
               TRUE ~ status)
      ) %>% 
      select(gene, status, identity_human2mouse, gene_set) %>% 
      distinct(),
    # Bind with the total ortholog reference set
    gene_info_human %>% 
      distinct() %>% 
      mutate(status = "All", gene_set = "All") %>% 
      select(gene, status, identity_human2mouse, gene_set) %>% 
      distinct()
  ) %>% 
  # 2. Relevel status for logical visualization flow
  mutate(status = fct_relevel(status, "Human only", "Mouse only", "Shared", 
                              "Immune BTMs", "ENERGY METABOLISM", "ECM AND MIGRATION", 
                              "CELL CYCLE", "SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION", "PLATELETS", "All")) %>% 
  # 3. Integrate with functional correlation results
  left_join(dge_btm_process_genes_correlation_bygene,
            by = join_by(gene == symbol)) %>% 
  filter(gene_set == "Human vs. Mouse" | !is.na(cor_value))

# 4. Calculate gene frequency (How many conditions/pathogens each gene appears in)
alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared = alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df %>%
  #Get n shared conditions by status of a gene
  filter(status %in% c("Mouse only", "Human only", "Shared")) %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  select(gene, status) %>%
  group_by(status, gene) %>% 
  summarise(n_conditions_status = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  #Sum the n of shared conditions by status to the total and get the percentage and ratio
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  mutate(ntotal = sum(n_conditions_status),
         nstatus_to_total_pct = (n_conditions_status/ntotal) %>% round(2),
         nstatus_to_total = paste0(n_conditions_status, "-", ntotal)) %>% 
  
  #Get stats for shared vs. not shared
  mutate(is_shared = if_else(status == "Shared", "Shared", "Not-shared")) %>%
  group_by(gene, is_shared) %>%
  mutate(n_group = sum(n_conditions_status)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(
    n_shared = sum(n_conditions_status[status == "Shared"]),
    n_notshared = ntotal - n_shared,
    ratio_shared_notshared_pct = round(n_shared / n_notshared, 2),
    ratio_shared_notshared_pct = if_else(is.infinite(ratio_shared_notshared_pct), NA_real_, ratio_shared_notshared_pct),
    #Classify
    class = if_else(ratio_shared_notshared_pct >= 1, "Shared", "Not-shared")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df %>% 
               select(gene, identity_human2mouse, cor_value:cor_label) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "gene") %>% 
  bind_rows(alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df %>%
              filter(status %in% c("All", "Immune BTMs", "Non-Immune BTMs")) %>% 
               select(status,gene, identity_human2mouse, cor_value:cor_label) %>% 
               distinct() %>% 
              mutate(is_shared = status,
                     class = status))

#Save
alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared.rds"))


# 5. Final cleaned reference for identity distribution
alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_filtered = alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df %>% 
  select(gene, status, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
  distinct()



#Create a filtered dataset of exemplar genes based on identity and correlation
top_shared_notshared_genes = bind_rows(
    #Get mostly shared-genes
    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    select(gene, 
           # is_shared, 
           class, n_conditions_status, n_shared, ntotal, cor_value, p_value, r_squared, cor_label, identity_human2mouse,  ratio_shared_notshared_pct) %>%
    arrange(-ratio_shared_notshared_pct, -n_shared) %>% 
    filter(class == "Shared",
           n_shared > 3) %>%
      arrange(-ratio_shared_notshared_pct) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 50) %>% 
      select(-n_conditions_status) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
      arrange(-identity_human2mouse, -cor_value),
    
    
    #Get mostly not-shared genes
    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    drop_na(cor_value) %>% 
    select(gene, 
           # is_shared, 
           n_shared, class,  n_notshared, identity_human2mouse, cor_value, p_value, r_squared, cor_label, ntotal,ratio_shared_notshared_pct) %>%
    arrange(ratio_shared_notshared_pct, -n_notshared) %>% 
    filter(class == "Not-shared",
           n_notshared > 3) %>%
    arrange(ratio_shared_notshared_pct) %>% 
      slice_head(n = 50) %>% 
    distinct(),
    
    
     #Get All and BTMs genes
    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
      filter(status %in% c("Immune BTMs", "Non-Immune BTMs", "All")) %>% 
    drop_na(cor_value) %>% 
    select(gene, ntotal, 
           # is_shared, 
           n_shared, class, n_notshared, identity_human2mouse, cor_value, p_value, r_squared, cor_label, ntotal,ratio_shared_notshared_pct) %>%
    distinct()
    ) %>% 
  mutate(n_conditions_is_shared = ntotal)

#Save
top_shared_notshared_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "top_shared_notshared_genes.rds"))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
# --- Create a filtered dataset of exemplar genes based on identity and correlation ---
alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered = bind_rows(

  #SHARED vs NOT SHARED ============
  # POSITIVE CORRELATION, HIGH IDENTITY (>90%)
  top_shared_notshared_genes %>%
    filter(p_value <= 0.10,
           cor_value >= 0, 
            r_squared > 0.2,
           ntotal > 3,
           identity_human2mouse > 90) %>% 
    group_by(class) %>%
    arrange(-cor_value, 
            -ntotal) %>%
    slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Positive correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),
  
  # POSITIVE CORRELATION, LOW IDENTITY
  top_shared_notshared_genes %>%
    filter(ntotal > 3, 
           cor_value > 0,
           p_value <= 0.10,
            r_squared > 0.2,
           identity_human2mouse < 90) %>% 
    arrange(-cor_value, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
    group_by(class) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 100)  %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Positive correlation,\nLow %Identity"),

  # NEGATIVE CORRELATION, HIGH IDENTITY (>90%)
  top_shared_notshared_genes %>%
    filter(ntotal > 3,
           p_value <= 0.10, 
            r_squared > 0.2,
           cor_value < 0, 
           identity_human2mouse > 90) %>% 
    group_by(class) %>%
    arrange(cor_value, -ntotal) %>%
    slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Negative correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),

  # NEGATIVE CORRELATION, LOW IDENTITY (<90%)
  top_shared_notshared_genes %>%
    filter(p_value <= 0.10, 
           cor_value < 0, 
           r_squared > 0.2,
           ntotal > 3,
           identity_human2mouse < 90) %>% 
    group_by(class) %>%
    arrange(cor_value, -ntotal) %>%
    slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Negative correlation,\nLow %Identity"),
  
  # OTHER ==================
  # POSITIVE CORRELATION, HIGH IDENTITY (Immune, Non-Immune, All)
  top_shared_notshared_genes %>%
    filter(class %in% c("Immune BTMs", "Non-Immune BTMs", "All"),
           p_value < 0.10,
            r_squared > 0.2,
           identity_human2mouse > 90,
           cor_value > 0,
           ) %>%
    group_by(class) %>%
    arrange(-cor_value, -ntotal) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Positive correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),
  
  # NEGATIVE CORRELATION, LOW IDENTITY (Immune, Non-Immune, All)
  top_shared_notshared_genes %>%
    filter(class %in% c("Immune BTMs", "Non-Immune BTMs", "All"),
           p_value < 0.10,
           cor_value < 0,
            r_squared > 0.2,
           identity_human2mouse <90,
           ) %>%
    group_by(class) %>%
    arrange(-cor_value, -ntotal) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Negative correlation,\nLow %Identity"),

) %>% 
  # Final label cleaning and factor releveling
  mutate(
    class = str_replace(class, " ", "\n"),
    class = fct_relevel(class, "Not-shared", "Shared", 
                         "All", "Non-Immune\nBTMs", "Immune\nBTMs"),
    filter = fct_relevel(filter, 
                         "Positive correlation,\nHigh %Identity",
                         "Negative correlation,\nHigh %Identity", 
                         "Positive correlation,\nLow %Identity",
                         "Negative correlation,\nLow %Identity")
    )
```

##### Cellular component ontology

Evaluate sequence identity of Leading Edge Genes (LEGs) and other
categories across major subcellular compartments.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12}
# --- How LEGs are associated with identity, by gene cellular component ontology ---

gene_info_human %>%
  # 1. Integrate GO annotations with global identity and status data
  inner_join(
    alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_filtered %>% 
      select(-identity_human2mouse),
    by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == gene)
  ) %>% 
  
  # 2. Filter for specific Cellular Component domains
  filter(
    go_domain == "cellular_component",
    go_name %in% c("nucleus", "cytoplasm", "membrane", "extracellular region")
  ) %>% 
  
  # 3. Clean and reformat status labels for plotting
  select(hgnc_symbol, go_name, identity_human2mouse, status) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(status = str_replace(status, " ", "\n")) %>%
  mutate(status = fct_relevel(
    status,
    "Human\nonly", "Mouse\nonly", "Shared", "All", 
    "Non-Immune\nBTMs", "Immune\nBTMs"
  )) %>% 
  
  # 4. Visualization: Compare identity across GO categories using facets
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = status,
      y = identity_human2mouse,
      fill = status,
      color = status) +
  facet_wrap(~str_to_title(go_name),
             nrow = 1,
             axes = "all") +
  
  # 5. Statistical Summary: Mean and 95% CI via bootstrapping
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               geom = "pointrange") +
  
  # 6. Styling, Scales, and Legends
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$comparison) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$comparison) +
  labs(color = "Status",
       y = "%Identity",
       x = "") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = T),
         fill = "none")

# Distribution, boxplot and violin
gene_info_human %>%

  inner_join(

  ) %>%

  filter(
    go_domain == "cellular_component",
```

Visualize the global distribution of sequence identity while

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# --- Global Statistical Summary: Mean Conservation (Bootstrap) ---
alignments_human2mouse_pointrange_all_global = alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_filtered %>%
  # 1. Clean labels and establish the logical factor order for the comparison
  mutate(
    status = str_replace(status, " ", "\n"),
    status = fct_relevel(
      status,
      "Human\nonly", "Mouse\nonly", "Shared", "All", 
      "Non-Immune\nBTMs", "Immune\nBTMs"
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(analysis = "Mean Conservation, Bootstrap") %>%
  
  # 2. Setup the visualization: Aesthetics and Faceting
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = status,
      y = identity_human2mouse,
      fill = status,
      color = status,
      group = status) +
  facet_wrap(~analysis) +
  
  # 3. Layer 1: Pointrange with bootstrapped Mean and CI
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               geom = "pointrange",
               size = 1,
               fatten = 2,
               stroke = 0.5,
               pch = 21,
               mapping = aes(color = status),
               position = position_dodge2(0)) +
  
  # 4. Layer 2: Text labels for the precise mean values
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", 
               geom = "text", 
               aes(label = after_stat(round(y, 1))), 
               hjust = -0.2, 
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  
  # 5. Custom scales for fill and color (Mapping status to your project colors)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors$comparison,
                               "BTMs" = "#4361ee",
                               "All" = "white")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colors$comparison,
                                "BTMs" = "#4361ee",
                                "All" = "black")) +
  
  # 6. Adjust scales and coordinate system
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  
  # 7. Final Theme and Legend Cleanup
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.1, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0.3, 0.3, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
        legend.position = "none",
        ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Status",
       y = "%Identity (Human-to-Mouse)",
       color = "",
       fill = "")
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
#Boxplot and violin
# --- Global Distribution of Conservation with Highlighted Exemplar Genes ---
alignments_human2mouse_histogram_all_global = alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_filtered %>%
  # 1. Prepare categories and factor levels
  mutate(analysis = "Distribution of conservation",
         status = str_replace(status, " ", "\n"),
         status = fct_relevel(status, "Human\nonly", "Mouse\nonly", "Shared", 
                              "All", "Non-Immune\nBTMs", "Immune\nBTMs")) %>% 
  
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = status, y = identity_human2mouse, fill = status, color = status, group = status) +
  facet_wrap(~analysis) +
  
  # 2. Main Layers: Violin for density and transparent Boxplot
  geom_violin(color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(color = status), width = 0.1, fill = NA, outliers = F) +
  
  # 3. First Color Scale: Category status
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Status", values = c(colors$comparison, "All" = "white")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Status", 
                     values = c("Mouse\nonly" = "white", "Human\nonly" = "white", "Shared" = "white", 
                                "Immune\nBTMs" = "white", "Non-Immune\nBTMs" = "white", "All" = "black")) +
  
  # 4. Secondary Color Scale: Custom filters for highlighted genes
  new_scale_color() + 
  scale_color_manual(
     name = "Filter",
     values = c("High %Identity" = "#4361ee", "Positive correlation,\nHigh %Identity" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                "Negative correlation,\nHigh %Identity" = "#7209b7", "Low %Identity" = "red",
                "Positive correlation,\nLow %Identity" = "#CA6702", "Negative correlation,\nLow %Identity" = "#AE2012")) +
  
  # 5. Adding highlighted genes as points and labels
  geom_point(data = alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered %>% 
               group_by(status, filter) %>% 
               slice_head(n = 5), aes(color = filter), pch = 21, fill = "white") +
  
  # 6. Statistical annotation: Median identity labels
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "label", aes(label = after_stat(round(y, 1))),
               size = 3, hjust = -0.2, color = "black", fill = "white") +
  
  # 7. Gene Labeling: Repel prevents overlapping names
  geom_label_repel(data = alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered %>% 
               group_by(status, filter) %>% 
               slice_head(n = 5),
                   aes(label = gene, color = filter), 
                   max.overlaps = 10000, size = 2, direction = "y", nudge_x = -0.4,
                   hjust = 0, fill = "white", box.padding = unit(0, "cm"), label.padding = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
  
  # 8. Scales, Theme, and Layout
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), limits = c(50, 105)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0), legend.box.margin = margin(0,0,-10,0),
        plot.margin = margin(0.3, 0.3, 0, 0, unit = "cm")) +
  labs(x = "Status", y = "%Identity (Human-to-Mouse)", color = "", fill = "")
```

##### Align most conserved genes

Get global identity

```{r}
#Import
gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined.rds"))
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

shared_genes_df = alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered %>% 
  select(filter, status, everything()) %>% 
  group_by(filter, status) %>% 
  slice_head(n  = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

shared_genes = shared_genes_df %>% 
  pull(gene) %>% 
  unique()


# 1. Setup biomaRt
## Gene annotation
# human_mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
# mouse_mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

# 2. Retrieve Pfam domains, GO terms, and Identity
# We include homology identity to correlate directly
domains_human <- getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "hgnc_symbol",
    "interpro",
    "interpro_start",
    "interpro_end",
    "interpro_short_description",
    # "tmhmm_start",
    # "tmhmm_end",
    "phobius",
    "phobius_start",
    "phobius_end"
  ),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  values = shared_genes,
  # values = "ABCE1",
  mart = human_mart
)

sequences_human = getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "hgnc_symbol",
    "peptide",
    "uniprotswissprot"
  ),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  values = shared_genes,
  # values = "ABCE1",
  mart = human_mart
) %>% 
  #Filter out non-canonical/annotated sequences
  filter(uniprotswissprot != "")

identity_human <- getBM(
  attributes = c("external_gene_name", 
                 "mmusculus_homolog_perc_id_r1",
                 "mmusculus_homolog_goc_score",
                 "mmusculus_homolog_orthology_confidence"),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  # values = "ABCE1",
  values = shared_genes,
  mart = human_mart
) %>% 
  rename(hgnc_symbol = external_gene_name,
```

```{r}
# Pairwise sequence alignment
library(pwalign)
#Compare two original sequences
alignment <- pairwiseAlignment(
  pattern = gene_data$peptide_human, 
  subject = gene_data$peptide_mouse, 
  substitutionMatrix = "BLOSUM62",
  type = "global", # Garante alinhamento de ponta a ponta
  gapOpening = 10,  # Penalidade padrão
  gapExtension = 0.5
)

# Get identity score
identity_global <- pid(alignment, type = "PID1")

#Convert to a df
alignment_results_pairwise <- tibble(
  hgnc_symbol       = gene_data$hgnc_symbol,
  seq_human_orig    = gene_data$peptide_human,
  seq_mouse_orig    = gene_data$peptide_mouse,
  seq_human_aligned = as.character(pattern(alignment)),
  seq_mouse_aligned = as.character(subject(alignment)),
  identity          = identity_global
) %>% 
  inner_join(genes_domain_mouse_human %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(mgi_symbol, hgnc_symbol, identity_biomart = identity, peptide_mouse, peptide_human, uniprotswissprot_human,
         filter, status, n, cor_value, p_value, r_squared, cor_label) %>% 
  distinct(),
  by = "hgnc_symbol")



```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
library(tidyverse)

#Prepare data with biomart annotations  ===========
gene_info <- alignment_results_pairwise %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol == selected_gene) %>%
  mutate(
    len_mouse = nchar(seq_mouse_orig),
    len_human = nchar(seq_human_orig)
  ) %>% 
  slice_max(len_human, n = 1) %>% 
  slice_max(len_mouse, n = 1)

# Create "Full Protein" 
full_protein <- gene_info %>%
  select(hgnc_symbol, len_mouse, len_human, status, cor_label,
         seq_human_orig, seq_mouse_orig, filter, identity, identity_biomart, seq_human_aligned, seq_mouse_aligned) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("len_"), names_to = "species", values_to = "end") %>%
    group_by(hgnc_symbol, species) %>% 
  slice_max(end, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    species = str_remove(species, "len_"),
    start = 1,
    interpro_short_description_human = "Full Protein",
    interpro = "Full",
    species_end = species
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

# Get uniprot data  ===========
prot_data <- drawProteins::get_features("P06729 P08920") %>% 
             drawProteins::feature_to_dataframe() %>% 
  mutate(description = case_when(type == "TRANSMEM" ~ "TM",
                                 type == "TOPO_DOM" & description == "Extracellular" ~ "EC",
                                 type == "TOPO_DOM" & description == "Cytoplasmic" ~ "CP",
                                 description == "NONE" ~ type,
                                 description == "" ~ type,
                                 T ~ description)) %>% 
  separate(entryName, sep = "_", into = c("gene", "organism"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(organism = str_to_title(organism))

#Identify mutations ===========
# Extract positions from alignment
vec_h <- strsplit(unique(full_protein$seq_human_aligned), "")[[1]]
vec_m <- strsplit(unique(full_protein$seq_mouse_aligned), "")[[1]]

# Find divergences
diff_idx <- which(vec_h != vec_m)

# Map position and skip gaps
mutations_base <- tibble(
  align_pos = diff_idx,
  res_h = vec_h[diff_idx],
  res_m = vec_m[diff_idx]
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Get position intervals
    pos_real_human = map_int(align_pos, ~sum(vec_h[1:.x] != "-")),
    pos_real_mouse = map_int(align_pos, ~sum(vec_m[1:.x] != "-"))
  )

# Separate by species
mutations_human <- mutations_base %>%
  filter(res_h != "-") %>% 
  mutate(species = "human", x_pos = pos_real_human)

mutations_mouse <- mutations_base %>%
  filter(res_m != "-") %>%
  mutate(species = "mouse", x_pos = pos_real_mouse)

# Prepare table for ggplot
mutations_plot <- bind_rows(mutations_human, mutations_mouse) %>% 
  rename(organism = species) %>% 
  mutate(gene = gene_info$hgnc_symbol %>% unique(),
         organism = str_to_title(organism),
         type = "Alignment",
         description = "Mutations")
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width= 10, paged.print=TRUE}
# --- UNIPROT PROTEIN ANNOTATION PLOT ---
drawprotein_uniprot_ggplot = ggplot() +
  # --- MAIN CHAIN BACKGROUND (Dynamic length per facet) ---
  geom_segment(data = background_lines,
               aes(x = 1, xend = max_end, y = y_val, yend = y_val), 
               color = "grey80", size = 2) +
  
  # --- TRACK 1: TOPOLOGY (TOPO_DOM and TRANSMEM) ---
  # Drawing rectangles for extracellular, cytoplasmic, and transmembrane regions
  geom_rect(data = df_topology,
            aes(xmin = begin, xmax = end, 
                ymin = y_pos - 0.1, ymax = y_pos + 0.1, 
                fill = description,
                labels = description),
            color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  
  # Faceting by organism and gene for multi-protein comparison
  facet_wrap(~paste(organism, sep = " ", gene), ncol = 1) +
  
  # Manual color scale for the first 'fill' aesthetic (Topology)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EC" = "#4cc9f0", 
                               "CP" = "#3a86ff", 
                               "TM" = "#90A4AEFF",
                               "SIGNAL" = "#f72585"), 
                    name = "Topology") +
  
  # --- SCALE RESET ---
  # Critical: Specify 'fill' to allow a second independent fill scale
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + 
  
  # --- TRACK 2: DOMAINS AND FUNCTIONS ---
  # Drawing rectangles for functional domains and regions
  geom_rect(data = df_features,
            aes(xmin = begin, xmax = end, 
                ymin = y_pos - 0.1, ymax = y_pos + 0.1, 
                fill = description,
                labels = description),
            color = "black", 
            size = 0.2,
            alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Second fill
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", name = "Domains") +
  
  # --- POINTS: MODIFICATIONS (Phosphorylation / Variants) ---
  # Adding Diamond shapes slightly offset from the domain line
  geom_point(data = df_modifications,
             aes(x = begin, y = y_pos + 0.02, color = type,
                 labels = description), 
             size = 3, shape = 18) +
  
  # Color scale for points (PTMs and Mutations)
  scale_color_manual(values = c("PHOSPHO" = "yellow", "VARIANT" = "red"), 
                     name = "PTMs") +
  
  new_scale_color() +
  
  # MUTATIONS (Violin + Points) ---
  geom_violin(data = mutations_plot,
              aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.5, color = "Mutations"),
              fill = NA, size = 0.4, width = 0.2, scale = "count", adjust = .05) +
  geom_point(data = mutations_plot,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.5, color = "Mutations",
                 label = paste(align_pos, res_h, res_m)),
             shape = 124, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mutations" = "red"), name = "Alignment") +
  
  # --- AXIS AND THEME FORMATTING ---
  # Mapping the custom y_pos values to descriptive labels
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(unique(df_topology$y_pos), unique(df_features$y_pos)), 
                     labels = c("Topology", "Domains")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +

  
  #Label the start and end of domains
  geom_text(aes(label = begin,
                      y = y_pos,
                      x = begin),
                  data = df_features,
                  nudge_y = 0.15,
                  segment.linetype = 0,
                  hjust = 0.5,

  geom_text(aes(label = end,
                      y = y_pos,
                      x = end),
                  data = df_features,
                  nudge_y = -0.15,
                  segment.linetype = 0,
                  hjust = 0.5,

  # Custom lab theme and final adjustments

  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
```

```{r}
  }
```

##### Regulation

Annotate with gene regulation - TF Identify conserved Transcription
Factors (TFs) regulating specific genes in both Humans and Mice

```{r}
# --- 1. Clean and Parse ChEA Table ---

gene_attribute_chea  = read_tsv(here("tables", "gene_attribute_matrix.txt"))

gene_attribute_chea_clean <- gene_attribute_chea %>%
  rename(gene = Gene) %>% 
  # Transform wide matrix into a long format for easier filtering
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "experiment", values_to = "score") %>%
  filter(score > 0) %>% # Keep only reported TF-Target interactions
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  
  # Split the metadata string into specific regulatory components
  separate(experiment, 
           into = c("tf", "pmid", "method_tissue_species"), 
           sep = "-", 
           extra = "merge", 
           fill = "right") %>%

  # Clean strings and detect species (Human vs. Mouse) from metadata
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim),
         species = case_when(str_detect(method_tissue_species, "HUMAN") ~ "Human",
                             str_detect(method_tissue_species, "MOUSE") ~ "Mouse",
                             TRUE ~ method_tissue_species)) %>% 
  filter(species %in% c("Human", "Mouse"))


# --- 2. Cross-Species Evidence Counting ---
gene_attribute_tf_count = gene_attribute_chea_clean %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(gene, tf, pmid, species) %>% 
  group_by(gene, tf) %>% 
  # Pivot to compare PMID evidence side-by-side for each species
  pivot_wider(names_from = "species",
              values_from = "pmid") %>% 
  mutate(
    # Collapse list of PMIDs into strings and count them
    Human_pmids = map_chr(Human, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", ")),
    Mouse_pmids = map_chr(Mouse, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", ")),
    
    Human_pmids_n = map_int(Human, length),
    Mouse_pmids_n = map_int(Mouse, length)
  ) %>%
  
  select(!c(Human, Mouse)) %>% 
  mutate(across(ends_with("pmids"), ~ na_if(.x, ""))) %>% 
  # Logical check: Is the TF regulating this gene in BOTH organisms?
  mutate(both = if_else(!is.na(Human_pmids) & !is.na(Mouse_pmids), "T", "F"),
         # weighted_score = Human_pmids_n * Mouse_pmids_n,
         )

gene_attribute_tf_count %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "regulation_gene_tf_count.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Summarize Conservation ---

#Select genes
gene_attribute_tf_count %>% 
  filter(gene %in% c("XPO1", "CD2", "CDK14", "NDUFB10")) %>%
  # Join with your filtered gene quadrants (e.g., High Corr/Low Identity)
  inner_join(alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered %>% 
               group_by(status, filter) %>% 
               slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
               filter(status == "Shared"),
             by = "gene") %>%
  # Create a descriptive label for the final table
  mutate(gene = paste(gene, filter, cor_label)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(both)) %>% 
  # Generate a contingency table: Gene/Category vs. Cross-species status
  tabyl(gene, both) %>%
  adorn_totals(where = "col") %>% 
  adorn_percentages("row") %>%
  adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 1) %>%
  adorn_ns() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
gene_attribute_tf_count_filter_df_summary = gene_attribute_tf_count_filter_df %>% 
  # Create a descriptive label for the final table
  arrange(desc(both)) %>% 
  group_by(
          # filter, 
           gene, both) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(n),
         percentage = (n/total*100) %>% round(1))  

gene_attribute_tf_count_test = gene_attribute_tf_count %>%
  select(gene, tf, Human_pmids_n, Mouse_pmids_n) %>% 
  mutate(Mouse_TF = if_else(Mouse_pmids_n > 0, T, F),
         Human_TF = if_else(Human_pmids_n > 0, T, F))  %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  summarise(
    unique_tfs_human = n_distinct(tf[Human_TF == TRUE]),
    unique_tfs_mouse = n_distinct(tf[Mouse_TF == TRUE])
  )

gene_attribute_tf_count_filter_df_summary_annotated = gene_attribute_tf_count_filter_df_summary %>%
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
    select(-percentage) %>% 
  pivot_wider(values_from = "n",
              names_from = "both") %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  rename(not_shared_tf = "F",
         shared_tf = "T") %>% 
  mutate(shared_tf = if_else(is.na(shared_tf), 0, shared_tf)) %>% 
  inner_join(gene_attribute_tf_count_filter_df %>% 
               ungroup() %>% 
               filter(class %in% c("Shared", "Not-shared")) %>% 
               select(gene, class:cor_label) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by(gene)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(shared_tf_pct = (shared_tf/total) %>% round(2)) %>% 
    mutate(logp = -log(p_value),
         cor_value_abs = abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  #Highlight genes
  mutate(classification = "All") %>% 
  inner_join(gene_attribute_tf_count_test,
             by = "gene")
```

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
#Convert to wide
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>%

  select(pathogen, symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)))  %>% 
  #Remove duplicates
  select(-process) %>% 
  distinct()

#Convert to wide
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide =
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = organism,
      values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    select(
      symbol,
      pathogen,
      process, 
      timepoint,
      Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      Human = mean_l2fc_Human,
      adj_p_val_Mouse,
      adj_p_val_Human,
      group
    ) %>% 
  drop_na(Human, Mouse) 
  


safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%

  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

filter_1 = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            median_cor = median(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
gsea_hallmarks_results_core = gsea_hallmarks_results_all_matched %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/") 

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined =
  gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status)

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----
#Safe correlation 
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}
# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,

  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),
```
