```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
             size = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.2,
    sigma = 2)
    ) +
  #Filtered
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 shape = filter,
                 color = group),
             data = . %>% filter(filter == c("Mouse")),
             size = 1.5,
             alpha = 1
             ) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 shape = filter),
             color = "black",
             data = . %>% filter(filter == c("Mouse and Human")),
             size = 1.5,
             stroke = 0.5,
             alpha = 1,
             ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  guides(color = F,
         fill = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE,  nrow = 3,
                           keywidth = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                           keyheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                           override.aes = list(size = 3, shape = 21, color = "black"),
                           default.unit="cm"),
         shape = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE,  
                              nrow = 3,
                             keywidth = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                           keyheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                          override.aes = list(size = 3),
                           default.unit="cm")) +
  labs(fill = "Group",
       shape = "Significance",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)") +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0., vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal", 
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1),
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")
          )
```

##### Plot NES

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
dge_hallmarks_nes_group_correlation_df = dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "2", "Early hours")~"Early hours", 
                               pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
         facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))

#Plot correlation plot (NES)

#Plot all points
```
